papers.title: Intelligent Diagnostic Prediction and Classification Models for Detection of Kidney Disease
papers.architecture: Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Support Vector Machine, Naive Bayes, Decision Tree, KNN
reported_limitations: Missing data handled primarily by mean/median without uncertainty propagation
No external geographic validation cohort tested
Fixed 80/20 train/test split without repeated patient-stratified resampling
papers.reproducibility_status: Independently reproduced on local UCI-CKD partition

papers.title: Detection and diagnosis of chronic kidney disease using deep learning-based heterogeneous modified artificial neural network
papers.dataset: Hospital Clinical Cohort & UCI CKD reference (n=640 subjects)
papers.architecture: Heterogeneous Modified Artificial Neural Network (HMANN) combining Backpropagation MLP and SVM
reported_limitations: Combines image texture features (GLCM) and clinical tabular features without clear separate modality ablations
Custom hospital cohort not publicly hosted under open license
No probability calibration or uncertainty estimation
papers.reproducibility_status: Partially reproduced (tabular sub-components reproduced; ultrasound proprietary)

papers.title: Detection and classification of kidney disease using convolution neural network
papers.venue: Journal of Neurology and Neurorehabilitation Research
reported_limitations: Moderate sample size for deep 2D CNN training
Lack of standardized pre-training on general radiological domains
Does not integrate patient clinical history or serum biomarkers
papers.reproducibility_status: Not directly reproducible without proprietary ultrasound images
